knobDefs.label: Curve Mods Enabled
knobDefs.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.

knobDefs.label: Drift Regions
knobDefs.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.

knobDefs.label: Gravity
knobDefs.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it

knobDefs.label: Jump Strength
knobDefs.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)

knobDefs.label: Kill Y
knobDefs.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor

knobDefs.label: Max Fall Speed
knobDefs.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick

knobDefs.label: Move Speed
knobDefs.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1

knobDefs.label: Platforms
knobDefs.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body

knobDefs.label: Curve Skating
knobDefs.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.

knobDefs.label: Skate Curve
knobDefs.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.

knobDefs.label: Skate Max Gap
knobDefs.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).

knobDefs.label: Skate Snap
knobDefs.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps

knobDefs.label: Spawn Body
knobDefs.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box

knobDefs.label: Right Wall
knobDefs.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

knobDefs.label: Left Wall
knobDefs.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

knobDefs.label: Features
knobDefs.description: One row per collectible: id, center (x, y in world units), board-defined kind (star, boost, …), display glyph and message floated on pickup. collected is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.pickups — SET_FEATURES replaces it at runtime (boards that import collectibles), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected features survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact.

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact; generous values catch fly-through pickups.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED collects touched features; toggle to freeze the set as-is.

knobDefs.label: Hit Radius
knobDefs.description: Per-axis distance (world units) within which a patrol counts as touching the player; smaller values demand precise contact, larger values forgive.

knobDefs.label: Patrols
knobDefs.description: One row per patroller: id, the [x0, x1] beat it walks, its base y, its speed in units/s, and optionally waveAmp/wavePeriod for a vertical sine bob (waveAmp 0 = flat ping-pong). Current x/dir/t/cy/touching/hit are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.patrols — SET_PATROLS replaces it at runtime (boards that import patrols), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected patrols survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Player Spawn X
knobDefs.description: Player x assumed before the first BODY_MOVED arrives (match the body authority's spawn).

knobDefs.label: Player Spawn Y
knobDefs.description: Player y assumed before the first BODY_MOVED arrives.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the 33ms tick moves patrols and tests contact; toggle to freeze every patrol in place.

knobDefs.label: Checkpoints
knobDefs.description: Ordered along the run: when the player's x crosses atX the respawn point moves to (x, y). Must be sorted by atX ascending.

knobDefs.label: Invulnerability Window (ms)
knobDefs.description: Milliseconds after a accepted hit during which further DAMAGE is ignored, so a hazard overlapping the respawn can't chain-drain.

knobDefs.label: Max Lives
knobDefs.description: Lives seeded on INIT/RESTART; reaching zero fires GAME_OVER.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, DAMAGE and checkpoint crossings are processed; toggle to make the run harmless (practice mode).

knobDefs.label: Spawn X
knobDefs.description: Respawn x before any checkpoint is reached (match the body authority's spawn).

knobDefs.label: Spawn Y
knobDefs.description: Respawn y before any checkpoint is reached.

knobDefs.label: Doors
knobDefs.description: One row per gate: id, min-corner rect (x, y, width, height in world units) and the collected total that opens it. open/touching are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.doors — SET_DOORS replaces it at runtime (boards that import doors), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected doors survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach Margin
knobDefs.description: Extra world units padded around a closed door's rect when testing player contact (approximates the body's size).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, COLLECT opens doors and closed doors report contact; toggle to freeze every door as-is.

knobDefs.label: Locks
knobDefs.description: One row per winding lock: id, anchor (x, y in world units), ring radius, radial tolerance band, and revolutions required. swept/inside/unlocked are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.locks — SET_LOCKS replaces it at runtime (boards that import locks), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected locks survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED accumulates angular sweep and unlocks locks; toggle to freeze every lock as-is.

default.hint: hold still at the summit — slope 0
cross fast — v ∈ [7, 10] · your speed IS the slope

knobDefs.label: Gates
knobDefs.description: One row per velocity gate: id, min-corner rect (x, y, width, height in world units), the speed band [minSpeed, maxSpeed] that opens it, the hold required (dwellMs 0 = instant), the horizontal direction required (dir -1/0/+1), and an optional hint shown when denied. open/touching/denied/held/reported are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.gates — SET_VGATES replaces it at runtime (boards that import gates), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected gates survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach Margin
knobDefs.description: Extra world units padded around a closed gate's rect when testing player contact (approximates the body's size).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED tests every gate's band and opens/denies; toggle to freeze every gate as-is.

knobDefs.label: Pads
knobDefs.description: One row per floor pad: id, center (x, y in world units), and grp (0 = ungrouped, always live; N = live only while it is the lowest uncompleted group). lit is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.pads — SET_PADS replaces it at runtime (boards that import pads), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected pads survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (covers skating over the surface the pad sits on).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED lights touched live pads and reports group/set completion; toggle to freeze every pad as-is.

default.hint: the tail never ends, the area does
stay on the wave — the line clings near 0

knobDefs.label: Fills
knobDefs.description: One row per fill region: id, x-range (x0..x1 in world units), baseline the height is measured from, target area, rateMode (area | speed | ride — default area), optional hint, and the curve samples to interpolate. filled/frontier/reported are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.fills — SET_FILLS replaces it at runtime (boards that import fills), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected fills survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED paints every fill the player moves through; toggle to freeze every fill as-is.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED tracks the current zone and ages the card; toggle to freeze the card as-is.

knobDefs.label: TTL Ticks
knobDefs.description: BODY_MOVED ticks the card stays up after a zone crossing (≈ 4s at 30 moves/s) before it clears itself.

default.concept: x is a number you stand on
default.name: 1 · The Plain
default.objective: Catch 4 ★ — the line is your ground; mind the pits!

default.concept: slope = rise ÷ run = 1 ⁄ 2
default.name: 2 · The Ramp
default.objective: Climb the ramp — every step rises 1 for every 2 across. Catch 4 ★!

default.concept: y = x² ⁄ 16 — the bars are the function, sampled; the dashed mirror axis x = 0 pairs the floor pads — light one, light its mirror
default.name: 3 · The Valley
default.objective: Drop into the valley and climb its walls — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the summit is the local maximum — slope = 0 there
default.name: 4 · The Mountain
default.objective: Climb to the summit ★ — the highest point of the curve. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the curve never touches x = 3 — the dashed wall is an asymptote; the road fades as it climbs — trust the curve
default.name: 5 · The Pole
default.objective: The world breaks at x = 3 — jump the chasm and catch 4 ★!

default.concept: 1, 2, 4, 8 — each step costs double; the road fades ahead — trust the doubling
default.name: 6 · The Doubling
default.objective: The stair doubles: 1, 2, 4, 8. Find the springboard to the top ★!

default.concept: the bars are the area under the curve — a Riemann skyline
default.name: 7 · The Gallery
default.objective: Walk the skyline — the bars trace the curve. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: a shift: (x−4) slides the whole valley 4 steps right — same shape, new address; the ↑ pad carries the road's +k — ride it and the road rises to the high ledge
default.name: 8 · Shifts
default.objective: Skate the shifted valley — ride the ↑ pad: YOU lift the road to the high ledge — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the corner: slope is −½ on the left wall and +½ on the right — at x = 0 no single slope exists; the ⤢ pad retunes the right arm's a — dive the left wall for speed, then the steeper arm reaches the high shelf
default.name: 9 · Corner
default.objective: Skate down one wall — ride the ⤢ pad at the bottom: YOU tilt the road up to the shelf — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the inflection: steep, flat, steep — the slope's own slope flips sign at x = 0; the arrows lean toward the flat middle
default.name: 10 · Inflection
default.objective: Climb the S-curve — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the logarithm: a burst upward that flattens forever — doubling run backwards; left of x = −7 it does not exist; the road fades ahead — trust the slow climb
default.name: 11 · Log
default.objective: Leave the flatlands and climb the log — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: this ramp IS the valley's slope: far from the dashed line on the steep walls, crossing it where the valley bottoms out
default.name: 12 · Derivative
default.objective: Skate the valley's slope — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the shaded region grows as you run right — piling up strips of area is integration
default.name: 13 · Area
default.objective: Run right and watch the shaded area pile up — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: accumulation: the hill climbs fastest where the dashed bump is tallest — its height collects the bump
default.name: 14 · Accumulation
default.objective: Climb the accumulating hill — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: decay: every step right loses the same fraction — the slope stays −1/5 of the height (y′ = −y/5) — the dashed line is the floor y = 0.8 it sinks toward; the road fades ahead — trust the flattening
default.name: 15 · Decay
default.objective: Ride the decay down toward the floor — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the tail runs on forever and never touches 1 — yet the area under it stays finite: an improper integral
default.name: 16 · Tail
default.objective: Chase the tail toward y = 1 — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: each step is half the last: 1, ½, ¼, … — climb forever and never cross the ceiling 2; the last gap has no step — the ceiling is your answer, land on it
default.name: 17 · Series
default.objective: Climb the halving staircase — answer the limit to cross the final gap, then catch 5 ★!

default.concept: polynomials hug the wave: the line clings near 0, the cubic clings longer — infinitely many terms IS the wave
default.name: 18 · Taylor
default.objective: Skate the wave the polynomials are chasing — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: y = 0.6x + 3 has a removable hole at x = 2; the left and right branches meet at the same height, so the limit exists and the road can stitch
default.name: 19 · The Limit

default.concept: The secant slope between two points on a curve approaches the tangent slope as the points merge — average rate becomes instantaneous rate.
default.name: 20 · The Secant

default.concept: each step adds the same displacement ⟨1.6, 1⟩ — vectors add tip-to-tail
default.name: 21 · Vectors
default.objective: Walk the vector steps — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: The road is y = A·sin(B·(x − H)) + K. Touch the four glowing pads in order — A, H, B, K — to reshape the wave so every ★ is on a crest.
default.name: 22 · The Sine Wave

default.concept: slicing a hill z = f(x, y) at fixed heights gives contour lines — crowded contours mean a steep climb
default.name: 23 · Contours
default.objective: Climb the ridge across the contour levels — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the slope of z = 3 + x/4 + y/2 depends on direction: ∂z/∂x = ¼ under your feet, ∂z/∂y = ½ the dashed way
default.name: 24 · Partials
default.objective: Walk the x-slope — the dashed line is the y-slope. Catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the gradient ∇f points the steepest way up — the arrows always aim at the summit
default.name: 25 · Gradient
default.objective: Follow the gradient arrows to the summit — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: the pass is the trail's minimum and the cross-trail's maximum at once — a saddle point; the arrows run downhill into the pass
default.name: 26 · Saddle
default.objective: Descend to the mountain pass and climb out — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: each column is one sum; adding the columns across is the second sum — ∬ f dA is a sum of sums
default.name: 27 · Volume
default.objective: Climb the columns of the double sum — catch 5 ★!

default.concept: a flat road plus sine harmonics builds a square-wave staircase — Fourier synthesis as terrain
default.name: 28 · Fourier

knobDefs.label: Zones
knobDefs.description: One row per world band: id, display name, the one-line concept, the zone's objective text, and the x-range (x0..x1) the band covers.

knobDefs.label: Fog Regions
knobDefs.description: One row per fogged world span: x-range (x0..x1) and lookAhead — how far past the player the road stays revealed while inside. Small values force prediction (blowups), large values suit slow tail lessons. Empty list = no fog anywhere.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED tracks the reveal horizon; toggle to freeze the fog where it is.

knobDefs.label: Choice Gates
knobDefs.description: One row per gate: id, gate center (x, y — y is the option-platform surface the judge tests against), the hint floated on a wrong answer, and the options: id, dx offset from the gate center, the label drawn above the platform, and correct. solved/chosen are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.choices — SET_GATES replaces it at runtime (boards that import gates), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected gates survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around an option platform's center when testing a landing (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around the gate's option plane when testing a landing (covers small hops onto the platform surface).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED judges option landings; toggle to freeze every gate as-is.

default.hint: +k — you lifted the road
a·f — the road steepened; only a fast dive climbs it

knobDefs.label: Coefficient Pads
knobDefs.description: One row per pad: id, center (x, y in world units), the mod applied to the road while inside x0..x1 (a scales slope+height, b compresses/stretch period, h shifts horizontally, k lifts), and the hint floated on apply, and hop (true = the board teleports the player onto the reshaped surface — use when the mod steps the road far from the pad; false = the skate snap carries the player, preserving speed). applied is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.coefPads — SET_PADS replaces it at runtime (boards that import pads), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected pads survive respawns.

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (covers riding the surface the pad sits on).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED applies touched pads; toggle to freeze every pad as-is.

knobDefs.label: Min Speed
knobDefs.description: Body speed (units/s, from BODY_MOVED) below which no dot is appended, so a resting body doesn't pile dots on one spot.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED appends trail dots; toggle to freeze the trail (existing dots still age out).

knobDefs.label: Trail Ttl (ms)
knobDefs.description: Milliseconds a trail dot lives; at a 33ms move cadence ~600ms keeps the last eighteen positions. The ttl is also the natural length cap — no separate limit needed.

knobDefs.label: Curve
knobDefs.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) of the graph being ridden — the same table the body skates and the canvas draws, so the readout matches what is underfoot. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.curve — SET_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the probe derives the readout off BODY_MOVED; toggle to freeze it (the board hides the tangent overlays when probing goes stale).

knobDefs.label: Triangle Run
knobDefs.description: Horizontal leg of the rise-over-run triangle; the vertical leg is slope × triRun, so triRun = 1 reads the slope directly.

knobDefs.label: Tangent Window
knobDefs.description: Half-length (world units along the tangent) of the tangent segment and of the glow sample window around the contact point.

knobDefs.label: Auto Show
knobDefs.description: When true the tutorial opens on INIT for this run; when false it stays hidden until SHOW.

knobDefs.label: Preview trait
knobDefs.description: Trait rendered in the media position of the modal — the live, demo-driven preview of the mechanic (a bare game canvas, no shell chrome). '@trait.TutorialEmptyPreview' leaves the slot blank. Override with '@trait.<TraitName>' to show a board's live frame.

default.body: ← → or A / D to run · Space, W or ↑ to jump. Pits cost a life — run the whole line!
default.title: Run & jump

default.body: Land on a curve and riya rides the function itself — downhill speeds you up, uphill slows you down. Jump to kick free.
default.title: Skate the graphs

default.body: Collect ★ — glowing doors open at 20, 50 and 80. Dodge the ✖ bugs and grab 🚩 checkpoints: three lives only.
default.title: Stars, doors & bugs

knobDefs.label: Steps
knobDefs.description: One row per tutorial page: title, one line of body copy, and an optional demoId that plays a scripted live demo (std-tutorial-autodemo) for the mechanic being taught.

knobDefs.label: Scripts
knobDefs.description: Named cue scripts keyed by the tutorial step's demoId; each cue fires its event after `at` milliseconds of the demo clock.

knobDefs.label: Player Vector Arrow Offset Y
knobDefs.description: World units above riya's center where the velocity arrow originates.

knobDefs.label: Player Vector Arrow Scale
knobDefs.description: Scale factor for riya's live velocity vector arrow, matching the standalone vector world.

knobDefs.label: Camera Lead
knobDefs.description: How far ahead of riya (toward her facing) the follow camera centers, in world units.

knobDefs.label: Checkpoint Color
knobDefs.description: Marker color for the 🚩 checkpoint flags (success green, both themes).

knobDefs.label: Checkpoints
knobDefs.description: One checkpoint per zone entry (mirrors OwLives.checkpoints); rendered as 🚩 flags and consumed by the lives authority as respawn points.

knobDefs.label: Equation Color
knobDefs.description: Color of the transient equation burst fired when a skate engages (and of telemetry text).

knobDefs.label: Door Color
knobDefs.description: Bar and lock-label color for closed star doors (amber; the bar disappears when the door opens).

knobDefs.label: FX Hit Puff Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for hit / info puffs.

knobDefs.label: FX Presets
knobDefs.description: Look table for world-space particle effects.

knobDefs.label: FX Star Burst Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for star-collect bursts.

knobDefs.label: FX Unlock Sparkle Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + atlas for unlock sparkles.

knobDefs.label: Field Vectors
knobDefs.description: Static arrow fields from the multivariable zones (vector steps, partials, gradient field, saddle trails, volume slabs), offset into world coordinates.

knobDefs.label: Modded Road Color
knobDefs.description: Color of the reshaped road segment drawn once a coefficient pad applies (bright yellow — the lifted/tilted surface reads as the player's own edit).

knobDefs.label: Patrol Color
knobDefs.description: Marker color for the ✖ patrol bugs (danger red, both themes).

knobDefs.label: Player Sprite Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + SpriteSheetAtlas for riya. Set to {} to fall back to the colored dot.

knobDefs.label: Reach Radius
knobDefs.description: A star's own radius (world units) — the gameTick collects a star when it overlaps riya's painted sprite box, extended by this padding.

knobDefs.label: Riya Color
knobDefs.description: Core marker color for riya the dot (brand red — legible on dark and light themes).

knobDefs.label: Riya Halo Color
knobDefs.description: Soft halo ring under riya's core dot (8-digit hex with alpha).

knobDefs.label: Riya Sprite Height
knobDefs.description: World-unit height of the riya sprite.

knobDefs.label: Riya Sprite Width
knobDefs.description: World-unit width of the riya sprite (scaled by the math-canvas x-axis pixel scale).

knobDefs.label: Show Telemetry
knobDefs.description: When true, draws a compact x/y/v readout on the canvas near riya (teaching/debug aid).

knobDefs.label: Spawn X
knobDefs.description: World x riya starts at (must match the lives authority's spawnX).

knobDefs.label: Spawn Y
knobDefs.description: World y riya starts at.

knobDefs.label: Star Halo Color
knobDefs.description: Soft glow ring under each uncollected star (8-digit hex with alpha).

knobDefs.label: Terrain Color
knobDefs.description: Bar color for the ground/platform/bridge bars.

knobDefs.label: Trail Color
knobDefs.description: Comet-trail dot color (8-digit hex with alpha); dots fade out by ttl via std-fx-trail.

knobDefs.label: View Half Width
knobDefs.description: Half the visible math window's width in world units — the camera clamps to [viewHalfWidth, worldWidth − viewHalfWidth].

knobDefs.label: World Name
knobDefs.description: Display name shown in the in-flow top row as "riya · <worldName>".

knobDefs.label: World Width

knobDefs.label: Y Max

knobDefs.label: Y Min

knobDefs.label: Zone Label Color
knobDefs.description: Color of the zone name markers floating at each zone's start.

knobDefs.label: Zone Label Y
knobDefs.description: Height of the zone name markers (near the top of the fixed vertical window).

knobDefs.label: Zones
knobDefs.description: The twenty-eight curriculum zones in run order: world-x span and family band color for the canvas region wash. Display names/concepts live on the zone-card config; equations and guides import from the atoms (entity.zoneMeta).

knobDefs.label: Body content tree
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr for the tutorial preview frame: a bare math-canvas following the demo-driven body position, seeded from the board's static terrain/curves/stars.

knobDefs.label: Gravity
knobDefs.description: Downward acceleration for the preview jump arc (world units/sec²), matching the play body.

knobDefs.label: Ground Y
knobDefs.description: Marker rest height in the preview (spawn ground top + marker offset); the preview jump arc lands here.

knobDefs.label: Canvas Height
knobDefs.description: math-canvas display height in px for the tutorial preview frame.

knobDefs.label: Jump Strength
knobDefs.description: Initial vertical velocity of the preview jump (world units/sec), matching the play body.

knobDefs.label: Move Speed
knobDefs.description: Horizontal run speed of the demo-driven preview mirror (world units/sec), matching the play canvas.

knobDefs.label: Preview Player Sprite Asset
knobDefs.description: Sprite sheet + SpriteSheetAtlas for the live tutorial preview. Set to {} to fall back to the colored dot.

default.body: The solid hill is the accumulation of the dashed bump. Where the bump is tall, the hill steepens. Slide or grow the bump to reshape the hill.
default.title: Accumulation

default.body: Run right and watch the blue region grow. Each vertical strip you pass adds its height to the total area under the curve.
default.title: Area

default.body: The bars are the ridge z = f(x,0). Dashed level lines behind it are contours. Tighter contours mean a steeper climb.
default.title: The Contour Ridge

default.body: The V has two slopes. Skate each side, feel the kink at x = 0, then grab the a·f pad to steepen the whole V and reach the high shelf.
default.title: Corner

default.body: The S-curve y = x³/300 + 4 is steep, then flat, then steep again. The flat middle at x = 0 is the inflection, where concavity flips. Drift pushes you toward it; the tuning gem halves gravity for the steep right wall.
default.title: Inflection

default.body: Ride the exponential down toward a floor it never reaches. Each half-life halves the remaining distance. Collect ★ and the scale pad to feel the rate slow as the height shrinks.
default.title: Decay

knobDefs.label: Next Path
knobDefs.description: Page the clear overlay's Next button navigates to. Standalone default replays this world; riya-game-platformer overrides it with the next world's path.

default.body: The solid ramp is the slope of world 3's valley. The dashed ghost is the valley itself. Where the valley is flat, the ramp is near zero.
default.title: Derivative

default.body: The stairs follow y = 2^((x+8)/2): 1, 2, 4, 8. Grab the scale gems to double jump strength — apex grows like v², so double v quadruples height.
default.title: The Doubling Stair

default.body: A flat road y = 1 plus sine harmonics becomes a square-wave staircase. Grab harmonic pads to add terms, then ride the sum to every ★.
default.title: Fourier

knobDefs.label: Next Path
knobDefs.description: Page the clear overlay's Next button navigates to. Standalone default replays this world; riya-game-platformer overrides it with the next world's path.

default.body: The skyline is a Riemann sum. The shaded area grows as you move right. Pick the estimate that matches the shaded area at the gate.
default.title: The Gallery

default.body: The hill is z = 1 + 5·e^(−x²/18). Purple arrows are ∇f, pointing uphill. The hidden drift pulls you downhill.
default.title: Steepest Way Up

default.body: The graph y = 0.6x + 3 has a removable hole at x = 2. Approach from both sides; when the left and right heights agree, the road stitches itself.
default.title: The Limit

default.body: A logarithm bursts upward then flattens forever. The domain wall x = −7 is forbidden. Skate the curve, collect ★, then grab the phase pad to shift the graph and reach the far plateau.
default.title: Log

default.body: The hill has a summit. Climb until the slope flattens, grab +k to build a false peak, then reach every ★.
default.title: The Mountain

default.body: The plane z = 3 + x/4 + y/2 has two slopes. Walk the gentle x-direction; the dashed line is the steeper y-direction.
default.title: Two Slopes

default.body: Every spot on the ground is a number. Run right to make x bigger; gaps are missing numbers; the raised ledge is a larger value.
default.title: The Plain

knobDefs.label: Next Path
knobDefs.description: Page the clear overlay's Next button navigates to. Standalone default replays this world; riya-game-platformer overrides it with the next world's path.

default.body: A rational function has a vertical asymptote at x = 3. Skate the left branch, grab the tuning gem, and jump the discontinuity to the right branch.
default.title: The Pole

default.body: Each staircase is a line with its own slope. Skate the curves, collect ★, grab the ⚡ tuning pad to feel speed as slope.
default.title: The Ramp

default.body: The trail z = 2 + x²/12 dips to a minimum at x = 0. The cross-trail z = 4 − y²/6 peaks there. Same point, two behaviors.
default.title: The Mountain Pass

default.body: The yellow beacon slides toward x = 5 as you move right. The pink secant line connects you to the beacon; as the gap shrinks, its slope approaches the tangent slope.
default.title: The Secant

default.body: Each step is half the previous: 1 + ½ + ¼ + … The staircase rises toward the ceiling S = 2 but never crosses it. Choose the limit to reach the final star.
default.title: Series

default.body: The same valley has slid right and up. The dashed ghost is the original. Use →h and +k pads to translate the walls and reach every ★.
default.title: Shifts

knobDefs.label: Next Path
knobDefs.description: Standalone default replays this world; riya-game-platformer overrides it with the next world's path.

default.body: The bars are the curve y = 1 + 12/(x+12). It creeps toward y = 1 but never touches it — yet the shaded area between them stays finite. Skate, collect ★, and grab the →1 pad.
default.title: Tail

default.body: The solid wave is y = 3 + 2·sin(x/2). The dashed line and cubic are Taylor polynomials that hug it near x = 0. Grab T1 and T3 pads to widen the fit, but beware the red divergence zones at the edges.
default.title: Taylor

default.body: The bars are the graph y = x²/16. Skate the curve, collect ★, grab +k pads to lift the outer walls.
default.title: The Valley

default.body: Each step is the displacement vector ⟨1.6, 1⟩. Ride the current, fight it, then compose two vectors at once to reach the final stars.
default.title: Vectors

default.body: Each column is one inner sum of slabs. Walking across adds columns together. Light every slab to fill the volume gate.
default.title: Slab City

knobDefs.synonyms: states, stages, phases, statuses, lifecycle, workflow steps

knobDefs.label: Which field holds the status?
knobDefs.description: Entity field this lifecycle drives (e.g. 'status', 'state', 'stage', 'phase').
knobDefs.synonyms: state field, stage field, status column, lifecycle field

knobDefs.label: Target entity
knobDefs.description: Entity name whose status field this lifecycle drives (e.g. 'Contract'). Rebind per composition. Typed `entity`, so a rename of the bound entity threads through to this value automatically.

knobDefs.label: Which status moves are allowed?
knobDefs.description: Legal transitions as { from, to, event, label }. Only matching moves are applied.
knobDefs.synonyms: edges, allowed moves, status flow, workflow transitions

knobDefs.label: Back button label on the journal period detail band
knobDefs.description: Label on the band's back button, e.g. "Back to contracts".
knobDefs.synonyms: back text, return label

knobDefs.label: Content trait
knobDefs.description: The detail trait rendered below the navigation band (the DetailPanel + sections view).

knobDefs.label: Content trait
knobDefs.description: Trait rendered inside the app layout content area

knobDefs.label: What actions can users take on this record?
knobDefs.description: Buttons on the panel header. One primary at most; the rest collapse past maxInlineActions.
knobDefs.synonyms: record actions, detail actions, panel buttons

knobDefs.label: Allow editing the document?
knobDefs.description: When false the document look is a pure read surface: no header Edit button, no click-to-edit body, no click-to-rename title. Hosts pass a role condition here so read-only viewers get the page without its authoring affordances; the entity's own access predicates stay the enforcement floor.
knobDefs.synonyms: read only document, viewer mode, can edit, editing allowed

knobDefs.label: Autosave hint
knobDefs.description: Muted caption next to the Done button telling the author their work persists on its own.

knobDefs.label: Body content tree
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = panel (the default). See slideOverBodyContent/pageBodyContent for the other looks; any may be overridden directly while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens.

knobDefs.label: Which field holds the document body?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field on the loaded record that carries the rich-text HTML body the document look renders and edits (e.g. content, body, articleText).
knobDefs.synonyms: body field, content field, document field

knobDefs.label: Which field is the cover image?
knobDefs.description: Name of the image-typed field on the loaded record painted as the document look's full-bleed hero banner (e.g. coverImage, heroImage). Empty = no banner, the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: cover field, hero image field, banner field

knobDefs.label: Detail look
knobDefs.description: Visual treatment for the record surface. panel = an inline detail-panel in the page flow (bodyContent); slide-over = the same panel as a right-hand drawer over the list behind it (slideOverBodyContent); page = a full-width record page with roomier spacing (pageBodyContent); document = a wiki-page/note/article surface — big editable title over a rich-text body, no labelled field rows, click-to-edit with autosave (documentBodyContent / documentEditingContent). Selecting a look swaps which body tree renders after the record loads; any body may still be overridden directly at the call site.
knobDefs.synonyms: detail style, drawer, slide over, full page, document, wiki page, note, article

knobDefs.label: Document look body (reading)
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document while reading: the pure writing surface — editable title with the rich-text body DIRECTLY beneath it, Edit and the actions menu tucked into the header corner. Metadata never sits between title and content; compose the sibling RecordItemDetails trait beside this one for the settings rail. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data, because it is also painted by arms whose payload is not the record.

knobDefs.label: Document look body (editing)
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document during an editing session: the same surface with the body live and the header corner showing the autosave hint + Done. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data.

knobDefs.label: Done button label
knobDefs.description: Label of the button that ends the document editing session; work is already autosaved when it is pressed.

knobDefs.label: Edit button label
knobDefs.description: Label of the quiet button above the document body that starts an editing session (the body itself is also clickable).

knobDefs.label: Which fields appear in the record panel?
knobDefs.description: Each entry maps one entity field to a labelled row in the panel. Unlike a list row, a detail panel SHOULD label every field — the value stands alone here with no column header or repeated row position to name it.
knobDefs.synonyms: detail fields, record fields, panel fields, shown fields

knobDefs.label: Which field is the document icon?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field on the loaded record whose icon name renders beside the document title (e.g. icon). Empty = no icon, the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: icon field, glyph field

knobDefs.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
knobDefs.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch, so panel fields can use dot-paths like owner.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields

knobDefs.label: How many actions before collapsing?
knobDefs.description: Actions beyond this count collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu.
knobDefs.synonyms: inline actions limit, overflow threshold

knobDefs.label: When does this surface load?
knobDefs.description: init = a routed detail page; the record loads as soon as the page mounts (the default). event = an overlay that stays blank until a row-click OPEN_VIEW hands it an id, which is what a list-embedded slide-over needs — mounting an init-loading surface on a list page would fetch a record it has no id for.
knobDefs.synonyms: open on click, slide over, row click, blank until opened, list embedded

knobDefs.label: Page look body
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = page: a full record page, width-capped so field rows do not stretch past a readable measure (Almadar_UI_Beauty.md §3).

knobDefs.label: Placeholder text
knobDefs.description: Placeholder shown in the document body when it is empty.

knobDefs.label: How should the fields be grouped?
knobDefs.description: Optional titled groups over `fields`, e.g. [{title: Contact, fields: [email, phone]}]. Group into sections of 3-5 once a record carries more than about seven fields — a flat list past that is the cognitive-load problem Almadar_UX.md §1.4 (Miller) describes. Empty = one ungrouped list, the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: field groups, grouped fields, panel sections, fieldsets

knobDefs.label: Show the action buttons?
knobDefs.description: Set false for a read-only record view; a panel with actions nothing listens to is a dead affordance.
knobDefs.synonyms: read only, hide actions, view only

knobDefs.label: Slide-over look body
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = slide-over: the same panel as a right-hand drawer, so the list behind stays in place. Use when the record is a glance, not a workspace.

knobDefs.label: Which field is the subtitle?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field shown under the title (e.g. company, category). Set to "" for no subtitle at all — the right choice for the document look, whose metadata lives in the properties strip, not a second line.
knobDefs.synonyms: subtitle field, secondary field, subheading, no subtitle

knobDefs.label: Which field is the record's title?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field on the loaded record shown as the panel title (e.g. contactName, subject, title).
knobDefs.synonyms: title field, heading field, name field, label field

knobDefs.label: Browse look
knobDefs.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the whole browse surface. table = the default data-grid (bodyContent); dense = spreadsheet-style table with toolbar search (denseBodyContent); feed = chronological card stream (feedBodyContent); gallery = image-first responsive card grid (galleryBodyContent); master-detail = record-work split view — dense list left, clicked record's detail right (masterDetailBodyContent); triage = inbox-register compact rows for queue work (triageBodyContent). Selecting a non-table look swaps which body tree renders after rows load; any body may still be overridden directly at the call site for a one-off layout.

knobDefs.label: Table columns
knobDefs.description: Column definitions for table-style variants (dense). Each maps an entity field to a column with optional width / align / weight / format.

knobDefs.label: Which fields should appear as columns?
knobDefs.description: Each entry maps one entity field to a display column with an optional label and variant.
knobDefs.synonyms: visible columns, displayed fields, card fields, column list

knobDefs.label: Search box placeholder text
knobDefs.description: Hint text inside the list search box (e.g. 'Search orders…').
knobDefs.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label

knobDefs.label: Content
knobDefs.description: Text content (alternative to children)

knobDefs.label: Label
knobDefs.description: Button label text (alternative to children for schema-driven rendering)

knobDefs.label: Generate an invoice on each charge?
knobDefs.description: Off by default — charging only updates the subscription's lastChargeAt/attemptCount. When true, charging also emits SUBSCRIPTION_CHARGED and the organism's InvoicesSubscriptionChargeListener sibling (InvoicesOrbital) persists an InvoiceRecord per charge.
knobDefs.synonyms: recurring invoices, auto-invoice, invoice on charge, bill on charge, generate invoice

knobDefs.label: Content trait
knobDefs.description: Trait rendered inside the app layout content area

knobDefs.label: Columns to show
knobDefs.description: Each column maps to one field on the Subscription entity

knobDefs.label: Compliance jurisdiction
knobDefs.description: Drives subscription regulations per locale: 'US-CA', 'EU-DE', 'UK', etc. Declarative.

knobDefs.label: Default currency
knobDefs.description: ISO 4217 currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, …) for new subscriptions.

knobDefs.label: Generate invoice on charge
knobDefs.description: When true, CHARGE also emits SUBSCRIPTION_CHARGED so the organism's invoice sibling persists an InvoiceRecord; when false (default) CHARGE only updates the subscription's lastChargeAt/attemptCount.

knobDefs.label: Grace period (days)
knobDefs.description: Days after a failed charge before the subscription is marked past-due. Wire via sibling std-lifecycle rule.

knobDefs.label: Row actions
knobDefs.description: Buttons users can click on each subscription row

knobDefs.label: Late fee policy
knobDefs.description: How late fees compute on overdue subscriptions. Declarative; wiring deferred.

knobDefs.label: Max retry attempts
knobDefs.description: How many times a failed charge retries before going past-due

knobDefs.label: Retention (years)
knobDefs.description: Years to keep subscription records for compliance.

knobDefs.label: Rounding mode
knobDefs.description: Sub-cent rounding behavior for subscription amounts.

knobDefs.label: Tax strategy
knobDefs.description: inclusive = tax baked into the amount; exclusive = tax added on top; none = no tax.

knobDefs.label: Section title
knobDefs.description: Heading shown above the subscription list

knobDefs.label: Idle content
knobDefs.description: The normal content view (e.g. the data ledger/browse trait) shown when no search is active.

knobDefs.label: Result columns
knobDefs.description: Columns shown in the search-results grid; maps entity fields to display cells.

Standard library behaviors are distributed as part of the @almadar/std package. Reference them in your .orb program by domain and name. The compiler resolves imports and validates compatibility.

Each behavior is a complete unit: entity definitions, state machines, UI patterns, and event contracts. You can use them as-is or override specific parts to customize for your domain.

knobDefs.description: Layer 3 body layout: default N-column data-grid ('columns'), or a Trello-style wide-column kanban with sticky column headers ('kanban-classic').

knobDefs.label: Body content tree
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the board loads for boardLook='columns' — the canonical column data-grid with nested per-column data-lists. boardLook='kanban-classic' renders kanbanClassicBodyContent instead; both share this trait's state machine, emits, and listens.

knobDefs.label: Show the board's own search box?
knobDefs.description: Renders an inline search box above the columns. Defaults false: unlike std-browse, std-board has never had a search box, so defaulting this true would silently add one to every existing consumer. The wired path — composing std-search beside the board and routing its FILTER/SEARCH event to REFETCH_QUERY — works regardless of this knob; set true only for a standalone board with no page-level search affordance.
knobDefs.synonyms: inline search, board search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

knobDefs.label: Card panel actions
knobDefs.description: Actions row of the open-card panel. Default is the Delete button only. Override to add consumer-wired actions — e.g. an Edit button with action: EDIT_CARD and actionPayload: { id: @entity.currentId, row: @entity.currentRow }, listened to by the organism's edit modal. Never leave a button here without a listener.

knobDefs.label: Card description binding
knobDefs.description: Per-card binding for the description slot.

knobDefs.label: Card id binding
knobDefs.description: Per-card binding for the id used in action payloads.

knobDefs.label: Card look
knobDefs.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for cards rendered by this board.

knobDefs.label: Card notes binding
knobDefs.description: Per-card binding for the notes slot shown in the card detail view. Set to an empty string for hosts with no notes-equivalent field — declared as 'no notes capture', never inferred.

knobDefs.label: Card stage binding
knobDefs.description: Per-card binding for the stage/status slot.

knobDefs.label: Card title binding
knobDefs.description: Per-card binding for the title slot.

knobDefs.label: Columns
knobDefs.description: Board columns; each row's stage maps to a column key

knobDefs.label: Which filters should appear above the board?
knobDefs.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the columns; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this board and routes its FILTER event to REFETCH_FILTER — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone board with no page-level filter affordance.
knobDefs.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, column filters, dropdowns

knobDefs.label: New-card fields
knobDefs.description: Fields shown in the add-card form

knobDefs.label: Grid columns
knobDefs.description: Outer grid column count before the board wraps

knobDefs.label: Group-by field
knobDefs.description: Entity field whose value matches a column key — items are filtered into columns by it. Default 'stage'; set to 'status' (or any field) for entities that track state under a different name.

default.title: التحقق

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how our sites and the Studio app are used so we can improve them.

- `_ga` and `_ga_*` are Google Analytics client/session identifiers set only after you opt in.

## Your choices
Analytics is off by default. You can allow or decline via the banner. You can also clear the consent cookie or enable Do Not Track.

## Contact
Questions? Email privacy@almadar.io.

knobDefs.default:
أسسنا Almadar لمساعدة الشركات الناشئة والفرق الصغيرة على تحقيق ما تستطيع الشركات الكبيرة تحقيقه. بعد أكثر من 15 عامًا في بناء المنتجات الرقمية، ظللنا نرى نفس الشيء: فرق صغيرة متوقفة بسبب أدوات إما صلبة للغاية أو سحرية بزيادة عن اللزوم.

نؤمن أن البشر يجب أن يكونوا في قلب الثورة القادمة للذكاء الاصطناعي، وليس فكرة لاحقة. لهذا السبب Almadar Studio هو منشئ المنتجات للبشر أولاً، مع الذكاء الاصطناعي كمساعد.

نؤمن بشدة بالسيادة الرقمية. النماذج المفتوحة والبرمجيات مفتوحة المصدر هي الطريق إلى الأمام. Almadar Studio مبني على كود مفتوح المصدر بالكامل، وعملاؤنا ليسوا مقيدين بمزود. هدفنا تمكين الناس من بناء منتجات لا يحدها إلا خيالهم، ومنحهم الميزة التي يحتاجونها للتميز.

knobDefs.default:
في Almadar، تصف منتجك مرة واحدة. ما يحتويه، القواعد التي تحكمه، ما يحدث عندما. هذا الوصف هو مصدر الحقيقة، ويبقى حيًا مع نمو منتجك.

كل شيء آخر يتدفق من هذا التعريف الواحد. المنتج يعمل منه ككود كامل يمكنك قراءته ونشره وامتلاكه. توثيقك يقرأ منه، لذا ما يراه فريقك في الويكي يتوافق دائمًا مع ما يعمل في الإنتاج. وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي يقرأون منه أيضًا، لذا يفهمون عملك بقراءة نفس ما يقرأه فريقك.

معظم الأدوات تولد الكود من توجيه وتنسى. Almadar يبقي التعريف في المركز، ويتيح لك تصديره أينما تحتاج: الكود، التوثيق، ووكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي الذين يعملون فوق عملك.

أنت تمتلك الكود المولد. أنت تختار نموذج الذكاء الاصطناعي. أنت تقرر أين يعمل. Almadar موجود ليمنح الفريق الصغير رافعة الفريق الكبير، لا ليجعلهم يعتمدون علينا.

knobDefs.default:
Almadar smo ustanovili, da bi pomagali zagonskim podjetjem in majhnim ekipam doseči to, kar lahko velika podjetja. Po več kot 15 letih gradnje digitalnih izdelkov smo vedno znova videli isto: majhne ekipe, zaustavljene z orodji, ki so bila bodisi preveč toga bodisi preveč čarobna, da bi jim zaupali.

Verjamemo, da morajo biti ljudje v središču prihajajoče revolucije umetne inteligence, ne pa pripomba za pozneje. Zato je Almadar Studio graditelj izdelkov, ki postavlja ljudi na prvo mesto, AI pa je pomočnik.

Močno verjamemo v digitalno suverenost. Odprti modeli in odprta koda sta pot naprej. Almadar Studio je zgrajen na popolnoma odprtokodni kodi in naši stranke nimajo zaklenitve ponudnika. Naš cilj je ljudem omogočiti gradnjo izdelkov, omejenih le z njihovo domišljijo, ter jim dati prednost, ki jo potrebujejo, da se izstopajo.

knobDefs.default:
V Almadarju izdelek opišete enkrat. Kaj vsebuje, pravila, ki ga urejajo, kaj se zgodi, ko. Ta opis je vir resnice in ostaja živ, ko vaš izdelek raste.

Vse ostalo teče iz te ene definicije. Izdelek deluje iz nje kot celovita koda, ki jo lahko preberete, namestite in posedujete. Vaša dokumentacija jo bere, zato se to, kar vaša ekipa vidi v wikiju, vedno ujema s tem, kar teče v produkciji. AI agenti jo berejo tudi, zato razumejo vaše poslovanje, ker berejo isto kot vaša ekipa.

Večina orodij ustvari kodo iz poziva in pozabi. Almadar ohranja definicijo v središču in vam omogoča izvoz, kjer koli jo potrebujete: koda, dokumentacija in AI agenti, ki delujejo na vašem poslu.

Almadar je odprtokoden od vrha do pete. Orodja, s katerimi gradite, koda, ki jo ustvarimo, in platforma, na kateri tečejo, so vsa odprta in pregledna. Nič vas ne zaklene. Nič ne drži vaših podatkov za talca. Nobena pogodba vas ne ustavi, da odidete.

Lastnik generirane kode ste vi. Izberete model AI. Odločite se, kje teče. Almadar obstaja, da bi majhni ekipi dal vzvod velike, ne da bi jo odvisno od nas.

default.content: Rules that exist only on paper somewhere aren't rules — they're intentions. A constitution has to actually be announced to the people it governs, in language they understand, or it has no more authority than a draft sitting in a drawer. Writing the rule and publishing the rule are two separate obligations, and skipping the second one quietly cancels the first.
default.title: Foundational governance documents must be substantive and public

default.content: Every transition — a migration, a handover, a change of leadership — is judged by what it preserves, not just what it accomplishes. You plan for the possibility of failure before you commit to the move, and once you've committed, you integrate gradually and keep what already worked. Tearing everything down and starting clean feels decisive, but it throws away the accumulated competence of whoever built the thing you're replacing.
default.title: Continuity through change

default.content: Whether it's a close alliance, a market transaction, or a negotiation between strangers, the same test applies: does either side walk away having taken something the other didn't knowingly agree to give? Closeness doesn't excuse exploitation, and distance doesn't excuse deception. The relationship only holds if both sides can see the terms clearly.
default.title: Fair, non-exploitative relationships between parties

default.content: A decision, a verdict, or a claimed truth doesn't become valid because the most powerful person in the room said so. It becomes valid because more than one independent perspective examined it and the reasoning held up regardless of who was arguing it. Rank can end a debate; it can't win one.
default.title: Legitimacy requires multiple independent voices, not positional authority

default.content: Oversight and transparency can't be something each part of a system decides for itself — if some domains get scrutinized and others don't, the ones that don't will be where the problems accumulate. Whatever mechanism keeps people honest has to reach everywhere equally, without exception carved out for the parts that would rather not be watched.
default.title: Cross-cutting concerns are built once and applied uniformly

default.content: An institution that begins closed rarely opens up later — closedness becomes its culture. Whether it's a place of worship, a court, or a public office, participation and openness have to be built into the founding design, because retrofitting openness onto something built to exclude almost never works.
default.title: Institutions need open, participatory access from the start

default.content: The instinct to act on a threat immediately is exactly the instinct that causes the most damage when the threat turns out to be imagined or exaggerated. Confirm what's actually happening, consult before escalating, and once you do act, match the response to the actual danger — not to the fear it provoked.
default.title: Verify before reacting; respond proportionately

default.content: Setbacks are inevitable; what separates a resilient group from a fragile one is what happens right after. Admit the failure plainly, find its real cause, and resist the urge to make an example of whoever was closest to it — because punishing the person teaches everyone else to hide the next mistake instead of reporting it.
default.title: Blameless recovery, fix the system, not the person

default.content: Novelty isn't its own justification. Before you turn to something untested, you should be able to show that the familiar approach was actually tried and actually failed — and once you do adopt something new, it has to be proven, repeatable, and written down, not just clever.
default.title: Prove the old way fails before adopting the new one

knobDefs.label: Aggregation
knobDefs.description: How values within a bucket combine into one number
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'count' / 'how many' -> count; 'total' / 'sum of' -> sum; 'average' / 'mean' -> avg; 'minimum' / 'lowest' -> min; 'maximum' / 'highest' -> max

knobDefs.label: Group / categorize / bucket / split by field
knobDefs.description: Entity field whose values become the chart's category buckets. Set this when the user voices 'group by X' / 'categorize by X' / 'bucket by X' / 'split by X' / 'break down by X' for any non-time field X (for time-units, set period + timeAxis=true instead).
knobDefs.synonyms: regroup / rebucket / categorize / breakdown by / split by / segment by. user phrases: 'group by status' -> categoryField=status; 'group by region' / 'by region' -> categoryField=region; 'group by category' / 'by category' -> categoryField=category; 'group by product' / 'by product' -> categoryField=product; 'group by month' / 'by month' -> categoryField=month (when explicitly requested as a category, not a time bucket); 'split by X' / 'break down by X' / 'segment by X' / 'bucket by X' -> categoryField=X

knobDefs.label: Chart type
knobDefs.description: Visual format for the rendered chart
knobDefs.synonyms: bar = vertical bars, line = connected line, pie = pie chart, donut = pie with hole, area = filled area chart, histogram = frequency distribution, scatter = XY scatter. user phrases: 'switch to donut' / 'make it a donut' / 'as a donut chart' -> donut; 'use a pie chart' -> pie; 'show as line' / 'line chart' -> line; 'as bars' / 'bar chart' -> bar

knobDefs.label: Drill event
knobDefs.description: Event emitted when a user clicks a chart point
knobDefs.synonyms: click-through navigation event. user phrases: 'on click navigate to X' / 'drill into X' / 'when clicked open X' -> X event name

knobDefs.label: Chart height
knobDefs.description: Pixel height of the rendered chart
knobDefs.synonyms: vertical size in pixels. user phrases: 'taller' / 'make it taller' / 'increase height' / 'bigger vertically' -> larger number (e.g. 300, 400); 'shorter' / 'smaller' -> smaller; 'set height to 300' / '300px tall' -> 300

knobDefs.label: Top N
knobDefs.description: Keep only the first N points after sorting (0 = all)
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'top 5' -> 5; 'top 10' -> 10; 'first 3' -> 3; 'all' / 'no limit' -> 0; 'show all' -> 0

knobDefs.label: Group by month / quarter / week / day / year
knobDefs.description: Group by month, quarter, week, day, or year — the calendar bucket the chart groups data into. Set ALONGSIDE timeAxis=true whenever the user says 'group by <time-unit>' or 'by <time-unit>' or 'rebucket to <time-unit>' or 'instead of <other-time-unit>'.
knobDefs.synonyms: regroup / rebucket / change bucket / group differently. user phrases: 'group by month' / 'by month' / 'monthly' / 'monthly buckets' / 'switch to monthly' / 'instead of quarter' -> month; 'group by quarter' / 'by quarter' / 'quarterly' -> quarter; 'group by week' / 'by week' / 'weekly' / 'weekly buckets' -> week; 'group by day' / 'by day' / 'daily' / 'daily buckets' -> day; 'group by year' / 'by year' / 'yearly' / 'annually' -> year. Whenever the user voices 'group by <time-unit>' BOTH period AND timeAxis=true should be set.

knobDefs.label: Series
knobDefs.description: Pre-formatted multi-series spec for stacked or layered charts
knobDefs.synonyms: multiple lines / bars per category. user phrases: 'compare X and Y' -> add two series entries

knobDefs.label: Show legend
knobDefs.description: Display the series legend
knobDefs.synonyms: true shows the color key. user phrases: 'show legend' / 'show the legend' / 'show key' / 'with legend' / 'with a legend' -> true; 'hide legend' / 'no legend' / 'without legend' / 'remove legend' -> false

knobDefs.label: Show values
knobDefs.description: Render the numeric value on top of each data point
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'show values' / 'show numbers on bars' / 'with data labels' / 'label the bars' -> true; 'hide values' / 'no labels' -> false

knobDefs.label: Sort direction
knobDefs.description: Ascending or descending order for the sort field
knobDefs.synonyms: asc = ascending = lowest-to-highest = low-to-high = smallest-first. desc = descending = highest-to-lowest = high-to-low = largest-first. user phrases: 'highest to lowest' / 'largest first' / 'descending' -> desc; 'lowest to highest' / 'smallest first' / 'ascending' -> asc

knobDefs.label: Sort by
knobDefs.description: Order points by value, label, or leave unsorted
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'sort by value' / 'order by amount' -> value; 'sort alphabetically' / 'sort by name' -> label; 'no sort' / 'leave order' -> none

knobDefs.label: Stacking
knobDefs.description: Stack bars, normalize to 100%, or render side-by-side
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'side by side' / 'grouped' -> none; 'stacked' / 'stack the bars' -> stack; 'percent stacked' / '100% stacked' / 'normalized' -> normalize

knobDefs.label: Subtitle
knobDefs.description: Secondary line below the title
knobDefs.synonyms: secondary header below the title. user phrases: 'with subtitle X' / 'set subtitle to X' -> X

knobDefs.label: Time axis
knobDefs.description: Group by timeField bucketed by period instead of categoryField
knobDefs.synonyms: true means group by date / month / time. user phrases: 'group by month / week / year / date' -> set timeAxis=true; 'group by status / category' -> timeAxis=false

knobDefs.label: Date field
knobDefs.description: Entity field used as the time axis when timeAxis is on
knobDefs.synonyms: the date / timestamp / created-at column. set when timeAxis=true

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Heading shown above the chart
knobDefs.synonyms: the chart's header text. user phrases: 'rename to X' / 'title it X' / 'change the title to X' / 'call it X' -> X

knobDefs.label: Value field
knobDefs.description: Numeric field aggregated per bucket (blank = row count)
knobDefs.synonyms: the numeric column to aggregate. empty string counts rows. user phrases: 'sum revenue' -> valueField=revenue + aggregation=sum

knobDefs.label: Render pattern
knobDefs.description: UI pattern used to draw the chart
knobDefs.synonyms: internal pattern selector. user prompts rarely target this directly — pattern selection is upstream

knobDefs.label: Collapse repeat notifications from one action?
knobDefs.description: When one action raises the subscribed event several times (a bulk import, a batch save), send one notification for the whole action (`perDispatch`) or one per distinct value of `coalesceKey` (`perKey`) instead of one per event. `none` (default) notifies on every event. Scoped to a single action: the next action notifies again.
knobDefs.synonyms: dedupe, deduplicate, collapse, batch notifications, one notification, bulk, coalesce, summarize, avoid spam, notification storm

knobDefs.label: Which field makes two events distinct?
knobDefs.description: With `coalesce: perKey`, the upstream event's payload field compared to tell repeats apart (e.g. `id` = one notification per record). Ignored otherwise.
knobDefs.synonyms: dedupe key, distinct by, per record, unique field

knobDefs.label: Email subject
knobDefs.description: Subject line used for the email channel. Falls back to `template` when blank. Ignored for other channels.
knobDefs.synonyms: subject, subject line, email title, mail subject

knobDefs.label: Event key for preferences
knobDefs.description: Stable key naming the upstream event this listener is bound to (e.g. 'OrderPlaced'). NotificationPreference rows (std-notification-center) whose eventKey equals this key — or is blank — apply to this listener's dispatches.
knobDefs.synonyms: preference key, event name, subscription key, notification topic

knobDefs.label: Fallback recipient
knobDefs.description: Recipient used when `recipients` is empty, instead of the acting user. The acting-user fallback (used when this is blank) is intended for personal notifications only — set this to an ops/team address (e.g. 'ops@example.com') for system alerts like low-stock or shipping notices, so the acting user isn't notified in place of the intended audience.
knobDefs.synonyms: default recipient, backup recipient, ops address, fallback address, notify default, alert owner

knobDefs.label: Frequency cap (per week)
knobDefs.description: Max dispatched sends per (channel, recipient) per rolling 7-day window, counted against dispatched NotificationRecord audit rows. 0 = uncapped. Applies to the persisted channels (email/sms/push/webhook); in-app toasts are not audited and not capped. A capped dispatch persists an audit row (`error: frequency-cap`, dispatched:false).
knobDefs.synonyms: rate limit, cap, max per week, throttle, send limit

knobDefs.label: Guard field (numeric)
knobDefs.description: Field read from the upstream event's `data` payload and compared against `guardValue` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. 'stockLevel', 'quantity'). Ignored when `guardOp` is `eq`.
knobDefs.synonyms: threshold field, numeric field, compare field, watched field, data field

knobDefs.label: Guard comparison
knobDefs.description: How to gate dispatch. `eq` (default) does string-equality via `triggerStatus` against the upstream event's `status` field, exactly as before. `gt`/`lt`/`gte`/`lte` instead numerically compare `guardField` (read from the event's `data` payload) against `guardValue` — e.g. fire only when a stock level drops below a threshold.
knobDefs.synonyms: comparison operator, threshold operator, guard mode, trigger comparison, numeric gate, greater than, less than, threshold crossing

knobDefs.label: Guard value (numeric)
knobDefs.description: Threshold compared against `guardField` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. fire when stock drops below 5).
knobDefs.synonyms: threshold, cutoff, limit, watermark, trigger value

knobDefs.label: Trigger events
knobDefs.description: Event names that should fire a notification. Set this to the upstream event name (e.g. OrderPlaced, CheckoutCompleted) so this atom listens for events from the orbital that emits them. The orbital owning this trait reacts whenever the named event fires anywhere in the schema.
knobDefs.synonyms: subscribe to event, listen for event, react to event, watch for, wire upstream event, observe event from another orbital, cross-orbital subscription, on-event trigger

knobDefs.label: Channel
knobDefs.description: Delivery channel. `in-app` (default) emits the in-app `notify` toast. `email`/`sms`/`webhook` dispatch through call-service at event time (email.send / twilio.sendSMS / webhook.send) and persist a NotificationRecord audit row with an honest `dispatched` flag: true only once the service call succeeds, false plus the failure detail in `error` otherwise. `push` looks up the recipient's PushSubscription row (captured by std-notification-center's subscribe flow) and dispatches web-push via push.send — a recipient with no subscription records the audit row undispatched (`no-push-subscription`). `webhook` requires `webhookUrl` to actually dispatch; a blank `webhookUrl` still records the audit row undispatched rather than failing. A per-user NotificationPreference row's `channel` overrides this value for that recipient.
knobDefs.synonyms: delivery method, notification channel, send via, dispatch through, push notification, web push

knobDefs.label: Push deep link
knobDefs.description: In-app path opened when the recipient clicks the push notification (e.g. '/orders'). Blank = the app root.
knobDefs.synonyms: click url, open on click, target path, notification link

knobDefs.label: Push icon
knobDefs.description: Icon URL shown on the push notification. Blank = the browser default.
knobDefs.synonyms: notification icon, badge image

knobDefs.label: Push title
knobDefs.description: Notification title for the push channel. Falls back to `template` when blank. Ignored for other channels.
knobDefs.synonyms: notification title, push heading, alert title

knobDefs.label: Quiet hours end
knobDefs.description: Hour of day (0-23) when the atom-level quiet window closes. Equal to `quietStartHour` = disabled.
knobDefs.synonyms: do not disturb until, silence end, night mode end

knobDefs.label: Quiet hours start
knobDefs.description: Hour of day (0-23) when the atom-level quiet window opens. Equal to `quietEndHour` = disabled. Dispatches inside the window persist an audit row (`error: quiet-hours`, dispatched:false) which std-notification-center's digest cycle drains later. Per-user quiet hours from NotificationPreference rows apply in addition.
knobDefs.synonyms: quiet hours, do not disturb from, silence start, night mode start

knobDefs.label: Recipients
knobDefs.description: Recipient ids/addresses. v1.1 uses the first entry; multi-recipient fan-out lands in v1.2 (gap). When empty, falls back to `fallbackRecipient` if set, otherwise the authenticated user.
knobDefs.synonyms: targets, addressees, notify to

knobDefs.label: Severity
knobDefs.description: info, success, warning, or error — controls styling
knobDefs.synonyms: alert level, priority, urgency

knobDefs.label: Suppression list
knobDefs.description: Recipient ids/addresses to skip (e.g. unsubscribed users). Suppression check runs before dispatch.
knobDefs.synonyms: block list, unsubscribed, opt-out list

knobDefs.label: Message template
knobDefs.description: Text shown to the recipient; supports payload interpolation
knobDefs.synonyms: notification text, message body, alert text

knobDefs.label: Trigger status
knobDefs.description: When `guardOp` is `eq` and this is set, dispatch only when the upstream event's `status` field equals this value (e.g. fire only when a record becomes 'approved'). Empty = fire on every subscribed event. Ignored when `guardOp` is a numeric comparison.
knobDefs.synonyms: on status, when status, status filter, only when, fire on, react on status

knobDefs.label: Webhook secret
knobDefs.description: Signing secret forwarded to the webhook service so the receiving endpoint can verify the payload. Ignored when `webhookUrl` is blank.
knobDefs.synonyms: signing secret, hmac secret, webhook signature, shared secret

knobDefs.label: Webhook URL
knobDefs.description: Destination endpoint for the webhook channel. Dispatch only fires when this is non-blank; a blank URL on channel "webhook" records the audit row with dispatched:false instead of crashing (a consumer misconfiguration, not a failure).

knobDefs.label: Channel
knobDefs.description: Delivery channel. `in-app` (default) emits the in-app `notify` toast. `email`/`sms`/`webhook` dispatch through call-service at event time (email.send / twilio.sendSMS / webhook.send) and persist a NotificationRecord audit row with an honest `dispatched` flag: true only once the service call succeeds, false plus the failure detail in `error` otherwise. `push` looks up the recipient's PushSubscription row (captured by std-notification-center's subscribe flow) and dispatches web-push via push.send — a recipient with no subscription records the audit row undispatched (`no-push-subscription`). `webhook` requires `webhookUrl` to actually dispatch; a blank `webhookUrl` still records the audit row undispatched rather than failing. A per-user NotificationPreference row's `channel` overrides this value for that recipient.
knobDefs.synonyms: delivery method, notification channel, send via, dispatch through, push notification, web push

knobDefs.label: Detail look
knobDefs.description: Visual treatment for the record surface. panel = an inline detail-panel in the page flow (bodyContent); slide-over = the same panel as a right-hand drawer over the list behind it (slideOverBodyContent); page = a full-width record page with roomier spacing (pageBodyContent); document = a wiki-page/note/article surface — big editable title over a rich-text body, no labelled field rows, click-to-edit with autosave (documentBodyContent / documentEditingContent). Selecting a look swaps which body tree renders after the record loads; any body may still be overridden directly at the call site.
knobDefs.synonyms: detail style, drawer, slide over, full page, document, wiki page, note, article

knobDefs.label: Which fields appear in the record panel?
knobDefs.description: Each entry maps one entity field to a labelled row in the panel. Unlike a list row, a detail panel SHOULD label every field — the value stands alone here with no column header or repeated row position to name it.
knobDefs.synonyms: detail fields, record fields, panel fields, shown fields

knobDefs.label: When does this surface load?
knobDefs.description: init = a routed detail page; the record loads as soon as the page mounts (the default). event = an overlay that stays blank until a row-click OPEN_VIEW hands it an id, which is what a list-embedded slide-over needs — mounting an init-loading surface on a list page would fetch a record it has no id for.
knobDefs.synonyms: open on click, slide over, row click, blank until opened, list embedded

knobDefs.label: Show the action buttons?
knobDefs.description: Set false for a read-only record view; a panel with actions nothing listens to is a dead affordance.
knobDefs.synonyms: read only, hide actions, view only

knobDefs.label: Which field is the subtitle?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field shown under the title (e.g. company, category). Set to "" for no subtitle at all — the right choice for the document look, whose metadata lives in the properties strip, not a second line.
knobDefs.synonyms: subtitle field, secondary field, subheading, no subtitle

knobDefs.label: Modal title

knobDefs.label: Show the gallery's own search box?
knobDefs.description: Embeds a search box above the gallery grid. Set false (the default) when the page already provides a search affordance (a toolbar Search molecule), so the surface shows one search box instead of two.
knobDefs.synonyms: inline search, list search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

knobDefs.label: Which filters should appear above the gallery?
knobDefs.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the grid; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this gallery and routes `XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER` — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone gallery with no page-level filter affordance.
knobDefs.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

knobDefs.label: How many images to fetch per page?
knobDefs.description: Records fetched from the server when REFETCH_PAGE fires (a composed std-pagination driving this trait). The initial load and revisit fetches stay unpaged (whole collection), unchanged from before this knob existed.
knobDefs.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, batch size, page limit

knobDefs.label: Which column does the search box match against?
knobDefs.description: Name the field on this entity the search box's str/includes filter matches against. Declared, never inferred: an entity with no `name` column must set this to a real field (e.g. title, caption) or the search box can never match a row.

knobDefs.description: Who can browse the question bank: public, internal staff, signed-in customers.

knobDefs.label: Video ID
knobDefs.description: YouTube video ID shown in the inline lesson player card

knobDefs.label: Acl
knobDefs.description: Object ACL — 'public' produces a public URL, otherwise the URL is signed/private.

knobDefs.label: Bucket
knobDefs.description: Target bucket; defaults to STORAGE_BUCKET.

knobDefs.label: Content
knobDefs.description: Object content as a base64 data URL, raw base64, or plain text (canonical shape); ignored when `file` is present.

knobDefs.label: Content Type
knobDefs.description: MIME type override for the canonical shape; inferred from a data URL when omitted.

knobDefs.label: Continuation Token
knobDefs.description: Pagination token from a previous call's `nextToken`.

knobDefs.label: Expires In
knobDefs.description: URL validity window in seconds; defaults to 3600.

knobDefs.label: File
knobDefs.description: File-form upload payload (as emitted by UploadDropZone); `content` is a base64 data URL.

knobDefs.label: Files
knobDefs.description: Files to upload, in UploadDropZone's `{ name, size, type, content }` shape.

knobDefs.label: Key
knobDefs.description: Object key to store under (canonical shape); ignored when `file` is present.

knobDefs.label: Max Keys
knobDefs.description: Maximum keys per page; defaults to 1000.

knobDefs.label: Max Size
knobDefs.description: Reject the upload if the file-form payload's declared size exceeds this many bytes.

knobDefs.label: Metadata
knobDefs.description: Object metadata stored alongside the content (S3-compatible object stores carry metadata as string headers — never structured values).

knobDefs.label: Operation
knobDefs.description: Which Object Storage action to run: upload, uploadMany, download, list, delete, getSignedUrl

knobDefs.label: Operation
knobDefs.description: Whether the URL authorizes a read or a write; defaults to 'get'.

knobDefs.label: Prefix
knobDefs.description: Only keys starting with this prefix.

knobDefs.label: Operation form
knobDefs.description: Trait that renders the Object Storage operation UI

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Menu title

knobDefs.description: Event emitted when the user picks a notification
